The more one-to-one attention children receive between ages 3 and 5, the better prepared they will be for kindergarten and beyond.

As a result of the intensive, individualized attention that Jumpstart provides, children build language and literacy, social, and initiative skills – skills that provide the necessary groundwork for later academic and social success.
